pdf_reader.description: PDF toolkit: operation=read|extract_tables|extract_images|extract_links|search|page_info|outline|convert_to_images|split|merge|extract_pages|metadata. Prefer read for text; use pdf_structure for academic outline.

file_path.description: Path to the PDF file. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

end_page.description: Ending page number (1-indexed, inclusive). Defaults to last page.

pages.description: Specific page numbers to process (1-indexed). Alternative to start/end_page.

query.description: Search query text for search operation.

case_sensitive.description: Whether search is case-sensitive. Default: false.

output_path.description: Output file path for merge/extract_pages operations. 生成文件只能写入会话工作区 outputs/ 相对路径。

output_dir.description: Output directory for split/convert_to_images/extract_images. 生成文件只能写入会话工作区 outputs/ 相对路径。

image_format.description: Image format for convert_to_images. Default: png.

merge_files.description: List of PDF file paths to merge (in order). 每项必须是会话工作区相对路径。

extract_metadata.description: Include document metadata in read results. Default: true.

include_page_numbers.description: Include page numbers in output. Default: true.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return for read. Default: 200000.

pdf_structure.description: Analyze PDF structure: page count, title, outline/bookmarks, heuristic section headings, figures/tables. Use before summarizing academic papers.

file_path.description: Path to the PDF file. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

citation_extractor.description: Extract reference/bibliography list from an academic PDF (marker, full text, DOI/URL when detected).

file_path.description: Path to the PDF file. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

word_reader.description: Read Word documents (.docx/.docm structure; legacy .doc plain text). Extract paragraphs, headings, tables, optional headers/footers.

file_path.description: Path to the Word document (.docx, .docm, or legacy .doc). 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

extract_tables.description: Whether to extract tables (.docx/.docm only). Defaults to True.

extract_headers.description: Whether to extract header/footer content (.docx/.docm only). Defaults to False.

preserve_structure.description: Whether to preserve structure (.docx/.docm); for .doc, splits on blank lines into paragraphs. Defaults to True.

excel_reader.description: Read Excel .xlsx/.xlsm: sheet by name/index, optional cell_range, output_format=records|dict|list.

file_path.description: Path to the Excel file (.xlsx) to read. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

sheet_name.description: Name of the sheet to read. If not specified, reads the active sheet.

sheet_index.description: Index of the sheet to read (0-indexed). Ignored if sheet_name is provided.

cell_range.description: Cell range to extract (e.g., 'A1:D10'). If not specified, reads all data.

has_header.description: Whether the first row contains headers. Defaults to True.

output_format.description: Output format: 'dict' (column-oriented), 'records' (row-oriented list of dicts), 'list' (raw 2D list). Defaults to 'records'.

include_empty_cells.description: Whether to include empty cells as None. Defaults to True.

csv_processor.description: CSV/TSV processor: operation=read|query|write|stats|convert. Read rows, filter/query, write output, compute stats, or convert formats.

file_path.description: Path to CSV/TSV: existing file for read/query/stats/convert; destination for write (write target must be under outputs/). Use write only when the user explicitly asked to save or export a file. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

delimiter.description: Field delimiter; if omitted, auto-detected via csv.Sniffer.

encoding.description: Text encoding (default: utf-8 with latin-1 fallback when omitted).

max_rows.description: Max data rows to return for read (capped at 10000).

has_header.description: First row is header (read/query/stats/convert). Default true.

filter_value.description: Cell value to match as string (query).

sort_order.description: Sort order when sort_column is set.

output_path.description: Output file path (convert). 生成文件只能写入会话工作区 outputs/ 相对路径。

html_processor.description: HTML processor: operation=read|extract_links|extract_tables|extract_metadata|convert. Extract text/links/tables/meta or convert to markdown/plain_text.

operation.description: Operation to perform on the HTML file.

file_path.description: Path to the HTML file. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

table_index.description: Zero-based index of a single table (extract_tables only).

output_path.description: Optional path to write converted output. 生成文件只能写入会话工作区 outputs/ 相对路径。

markdown_processor.description: Markdown processor: read/write/create/append/section edit/merge/convert/format/template. Use for structured markdown authoring and TOC/link extraction.

file_path.description: Path to the Markdown file (for read/write/append/prepend/insert/replace/delete/format/convert/merge output). 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

content.description: Markdown text content for write/append/prepend/insert_section operations.

sections.description: Sections array for create operation. Each has heading, level (default 2), and content.

metadata.description: YAML frontmatter key-value pairs for create/template (e.g. author, date, tags).

position.description: Where to insert relative to section_title (default: after).

output_path.description: Optional path to write output (for convert/generate_toc). 生成文件只能写入会话工作区 outputs/ 相对路径。

merge_files.description: List of file paths to merge (for merge operation). 每项必须是会话工作区相对路径。

template_name.description: Template to use for template operation.

template_data.description: Data to populate template fields (varies by template).

rows.description: Table rows for build_table (array of arrays).

items.description: Items for build_list. Strings or objects with {text, children}.

ordered.description: Whether to create an ordered (numbered) list. Default false.

file_path_2.description: Second file for operations that need two paths. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径。

text_processor.description: Text file processor: read/write/search/replace/insert/transform/stats/diff with encoding detection.

file_path.description: Path to the text file. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

file_path_2.description: Second file path for diff operation. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径。

encoding.description: File encoding (codec name). If omitted, auto-detect.

replacement.description: Replacement string for replace operation. Supports \1, \2 backreferences.

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences (true) or only first (false). Default: true.

regex_flags.description: Regex flag letters: i=ignorecase, m=multiline, s=dotall, x=verbose.

line_number.description: Line number for insert operation (1-indexed). 0 or negative = from end.

lines.description: Number of lines for head/tail. Default 20.

context_lines.description: Context lines around search matches. Default 2.

max_matches.description: Maximum search matches to return. Default 100.

transform_type.description: Type of text transformation for transform operation.

start_line.description: Start line (1-indexed) for extract by line range.

end_line.description: End line (inclusive, 1-indexed) for extract by line range.

start_marker.description: Start marker (regex) for extract between markers.

end_marker.description: End marker (regex) for extract between markers.

delimiter.description: Delimiter for split operation (regex). Default: page break or '---'.

chunk_lines.description: Lines per chunk for split by line count.

output_dir.description: Output directory for split operation. 生成文件只能写入会话工作区 outputs/ 相对路径。

source_files.description: List of file paths to join/concatenate. 每项必须是会话工作区相对路径。

encodings.description: Codec names to try for try_decodings.

sort_reverse.description: Reverse sort order for sort_lines. Default false.

sort_key.description: Sort key for sort_lines. Default: alpha.

image_ocr.description: Extract text from an image (PNG/JPG/WEBP/...) via cloud OCR. Pass workspace file_path. Optional lang=ch|en|ch_en or custom prompt. Backend selected by OCR_TYPE (vlm-ocr / deepseek-ocr).

file_path.description: 图片文件路径 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

data_clean.description: Clean tabular data: dedupe, fill/drop missing, trim whitespace, normalize types. For fill_missing with a literal value, pass fill_value (not value). Input via data / source_path / artifact.

operations.description: List of cleaning operations to apply in order.

columns.description: Columns to apply operation to. If empty, applies to all columns.

keep.description: For remove_duplicates: which duplicate to keep.

fill_value.description: For fill_missing with fill_strategy='value': literal value to use; do not use 'value'.

fill_strategy.description: For fill_missing: strategy to use; 'value' requires fill_value.

axis.description: For drop_missing: drop rows or columns.

how.description: For drop_missing: drop if 'any' or 'all' values are missing.

thresh.description: For drop_missing: minimum non-null values required.

type_map.description: For normalize_types: column to type mapping.

data.description: Input rows as a list of objects. Provide either this, 'artifact', or 'source_path'.

artifact.description: Artifact reference to tabular data stored outside the message payload. Use instead of inlining large datasets. 同会话可见的 Artifact ID，或会话工作区相对路径。

source_path.description: Path to a local JSON/JSONL/CSV/Parquet file. Convenience alias for 'artifact'. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

max_rows.description: Truncate the loaded input to this many rows.

spill_rows.description: Spill the output to storage when it exceeds this many rows. Default: 50000.

spill_bytes.description: Spill the output when the encoded size exceeds this many bytes. Default: 5242880.

force_spill.description: Always spill the output to storage regardless of size.

data_merge.description: Merge/join tabular datasets: operation=merge|concat, how=inner|outer|left|right|cross. Provide left_data/right_data or left_artifact/right_artifact or datasets list.

left_data.description: Left dataset as list of records. 内联行记录、会话工作区路径或授权 Artifact ID。

right_data.description: Right dataset as list of records. 内联行记录、会话工作区路径或授权 Artifact ID。

datasets.description: Multiple datasets for concatenation (alternative to left/right). Each entry may be either an inline array of records or an artifact-ref object. 内联记录集或会话工作区路径/授权 Artifact ID 列表。

left_artifact.description: Artifact reference to tabular data stored outside the message payload. Use instead of inlining large datasets. 同会话可见的 Artifact ID，或会话工作区相对路径。

right_artifact.description: Artifact reference to tabular data stored outside the message payload. Use instead of inlining large datasets. 同会话可见的 Artifact ID，或会话工作区相对路径。

max_rows.description: Truncate the loaded input to this many rows.

spill_rows.description: Spill the output to storage when it exceeds this many rows. Default: 50000.

spill_bytes.description: Spill the output when the encoded size exceeds this many bytes. Default: 5242880.

force_spill.description: Always spill the output to storage regardless of size.

operation.description: Operation type: 'merge' for joins, 'concat' for stacking.

on.description: Column(s) to join on (must exist in both datasets).

left_on.description: Column(s) from left dataset to join on.

right_on.description: Column(s) from right dataset to join on.

concat_axis.description: For concat: stack rows or columns.

ignore_index.description: For concat: reset index after concatenation.

data.description: Input rows as a list of objects. Provide either this, 'artifact', or 'source_path'.

artifact.description: Artifact reference to tabular data stored outside the message payload. Use instead of inlining large datasets. 同会话可见的 Artifact ID，或会话工作区相对路径。

source_path.description: Path to a local JSON/JSONL/CSV/Parquet file. Convenience alias for 'artifact'. 接受会话工作区 inputs/ 或 outputs/ 相对路径，或同会话可见的 Artifact ID。

data_transform.description: Transform tabular data: rename columns, cast types, map values, derive columns, string upper/lower/strip. Pass transformations=[{type, ...}] (operations is accepted as alias).

transformations.description: List of transformation operations to apply in order.

columns.description: For rename: mapping of old names to new names.

datetime_format.description: For cast to datetime: strptime format string.

default.description: For map_values: default value for unmapped values.

expression.description: For derive: Python expression using column names.

new_column.description: For derive/split/combine: name of the new column.

delimiter.description: For split: delimiter to split on.

split_index.description: For split: which part to keep (0-indexed).

pattern.description: For extract: regex pattern with capture group.

artifact.description: Artifact reference to tabular data stored outside the message payload. Use instead of inlining large datasets. 同会话可见的 Artifact ID，或会话工作区相对路径。

spill_rows.description: Spill the output to storage when it exceeds this many rows. Default: 50000.

spill_bytes.description: Spill the output when the encoded size exceeds this many bytes. Default: 5242880.

force_spill.description: Always spill the output to storage regardless of size.

data_aggregate.description: Aggregate tabular data: operation=groupby|pivot|describe|value_counts|rolling. Supports sum/avg/count/min/max and pivot tables. Input via data (records), source_path, or artifact.

pivot_index.description: For pivot: columns to use as index.

pivot_columns.description: For pivot: columns to pivot into column headers.

fill_value.description: Value to fill missing cells in pivot.

normalize.description: For value_counts: return proportions instead of counts.

top_n.description: For value_counts: return only top N values.

window_column.description: For rolling: column to apply rolling window to.

data_validate.description: Validate tabular data against schema/rules: types, ranges, required fields, regex patterns, uniqueness. Returns validation report (not a transformed table).

required.description: Whether the column must have non-null values.

required_columns.description: List of columns that must exist.

unique_together.description: Column combinations that must be unique together.

return_valid_rows.description: Return only valid rows in output.

sql_query.description: Read-only SQL SELECT on tabular data (JOIN/WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY/aggregates). Provide query + tables map or data/source_path (registered as table 'data'). Destructive SQL is rejected.

query.description: SQL query to execute. Only SELECT queries are allowed.

tables.description: Named tables as mapping of table_name to rows. Each value may be an inline array of records or an artifact-ref object. 表名映射到内联记录集、会话工作区路径或授权 Artifact ID。

data.description: Single table data (will be available as 'data' table).

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (applied if query has no LIMIT).

explain.description: Return query explanation instead of executing.
